name: FusionAuth
description: Full-featured customer identity and access management platform with SSO, MFA, and user registration workflows.

envVars.description: Password for the FusionAuth Postgres role
JVM heap size for the FusionAuth application

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DATABASE_URL: "jdbc:postgresql://{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/fusionauth"
      DATABASE_ROOT_USERNAME: fusionauth
      DATABASE_ROOT_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      DATABASE_USERNAME: fusionauth
      DATABASE_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      SEARCH_TYPE: database
      FUSIONAUTH_APP_RUNTIME_MODE: production
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      FUSIONAUTH_APP_MEMORY: {{env.FUSIONAUTH_APP_MEMORY}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/config:/usr/local/fusionauth/config
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: fusionauth
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: fusionauth
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
